title: Extend a finite simplicial map after refinement
statement: Let X be qcqs, U,V finite split étale hypercovers, r≥0 and t:trunc_r(U)→trunc_r(V). There are a finite split hypercover W, refinements a:W→U and b:W→V, and e:trunc_r(W)≅trunc_r(U), with trunc_r(a)=e.hom and trunc_r(b)=e.hom≫t.

proof.text: Use the product hypercover U×V. Evaluation by finite truncation preserves products, so the pair (identity,t), followed by the inverse product-comparison isomorphism, is a replacement-stage map from the finite truncation of U to U×V. Extend this prescribed replacement stage, and compose its refinement with the two product projections. The projection equations for the product comparison identify the two truncated refinements with e and e followed by t.

theorem exists_refinement_extending_finite_map
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (r : ℕ)
    (t : (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj U.simplicial ⟶
      (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj V.simplicial) :
    ∃ (W : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X) (a : W.Refinement U) (b : W.Refinement V)
      (e : (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj W.simplicial ≅
        (SimplicialObject.truncation r).obj U.simplicial),
      (SimplicialObject.truncation r).map a = e.hom ∧
        (SimplicialObject.truncation r).map b = e.hom ≫ t
